data.title: Address Residences Zabeel
data.about:
Address Residences Zabeel by Emaar is an iconic new residential development by Address Hotels + Resorts, set in the heart of Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). Comprising four striking towers, this landmark project offers an array of units ranging from 1-bedroom apartments to spacious penthouses. Each tower rises above the city skyline, boasting breathtaking views of landmarks like Burj Khalifa, Dubai Creek, and Zabeel Park. From elegant 

Residents of Address Residences Zabeel will also enjoy access to world-class amenities, including panoramic pools, a state-of-the-art gym, yoga decks, shaded kids’ areas, and serene lounge terraces. The project’s podium level is crafted as a vibrant social hub with lush landscaped lawns, barbecue pods, and floating decks that blend community living with urban serenity.

characteristics_module.title: Unmatched Views, Unbeatable Location: Address Residences Zabeel Apartments in DIFC
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Developed by Address Hotels + Resorts, the project promises a signature standard of elegance, sophistication, and refined design.
  • Set in the prestigious Zabeel District, residents enjoy a peaceful, green setting with the convenience of city life just moments away.
  • The project features four uniquely designed towers, each offering breathtaking panoramic views of Burj Khalifa, Dubai Creek, Zabeel Park, and the Dubai Frame.
  • Luxurious penthouses crown the towers, offering unmatched privacy, expansive living space, and panoramic skyline vistas.
  • Residents enjoy world-class amenities including panoramic pools, floating decks, a yoga deck, a fully-equipped gym, shaded kids’ play areas, and barbecue pods.
  • The podium level serves as a vibrant social and recreational hub, seamlessly merging comfort, leisure, and community living.

location_tile.title: Address Residences Zabeel: Your Place in the World’s Financial Pulse
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Address Residences Zabeel is ideally positioned in the iconic Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), placing residents at the doorstep of some of the city’s most prestigious landmarks. DIFC is the city’s premier financial hub, where global business, luxury living, and cultural sophistication converge. From world-renowned art galleries and Michelin-starred restaurants to luxury hotels, DIFC is a dynamic destination.

  • Within walking distance of Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre and Zabeel Park
  • A few minutes to Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC)
  • 05 minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 17 minutes to Dubai International Airport

more_info.answer: Address Residences Zabeel is located in the prestigious Zabeel district of Dubai, just minutes away from DIFC, Downtown Dubai, and Dubai International Airport.
more_info.question: Where is Address Residences Zabeel located?

more_info.answer: The project is developed by Emaar Properties under the luxury hospitality brand Address Hotels + Resorts.
more_info.question: Who is the developer of Address Residences Zabeel?

more_info.answer: The development offers a range of luxurious 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive penthouses across four architecturally distinct towers.
more_info.question: What types of units are available at Address Residences Zabeel?

more_info.answer: Residents can enjoy premium amenities including panoramic swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, yoga deck, pool cabanas, shaded kids’ play areas, barbecue pods, and lush landscaped terraces.
more_info.question: What are the standout amenities offered at Address Residences Zabeel?

more_info.answer: Depending on the tower and apartment, residents can enjoy breathtaking views of Burj Khalifa, Dubai Creek, Dubai Frame, Zabeel Park, and the surrounding skyline.
more_info.question: What views can residents expect from the towers?

more_info.answer: The four towers range in height from 198.85 meters (Tower 1) to 232.85 meters (Tower 2), offering between 50 to 58 floors.
